messages:
ela: Opening a small PR to add a Split-DNS + Egress Proxy section for Private installs that need to reach on-prem KMS/HSM while keeping customer data traffic local. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/PROXY-DNS. Need network + SDK review for proxy examples.

mohit: Nice. Key asks: show stub resolver config (systemd-resolved/Unbound) for split-horizon, how to set DNS over TLS for upstream, and an example http proxy chain (squid/mitmproxy) for air-gapped environments.

kat: Also include SDK examples showing how to respect HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY and SOCKS5 env vars and fallback behavior. A short Node.js fetch + axios snippet would help customers.

ela: Draft resolver example I'll add: systemd-resolved drop-in that routes kms.example.com to 10.250.200.10 (local) and everything else to the egress proxy.

```ini
# /etc/systemd/resolved.conf.d/10-redwood-split.conf
[Resolve]
DNS=169.254.169.253
Domains=~kms.example.com
DNSStubListener=yes
FallbackDNS=1.1.1.1
```

# add static host for kms in /etc/hosts or use NSSDB for greater control
10.250.200.10 kms.example.com

mohit: For Unbound show a minimal forward-zone config: forward zone for kms.example.com -> 10.250.200.10 and tls-upstream for the corporate egress proxy.

kat: SDK snippet (Node) suggestion: show respecting HTTPS_PROXY and a retry fallback when proxy auth fails. Short example:

```js
// axios with proxy env fallback
const axios = require('axios');
const proxy = process.env.HTTPS_PROXY || process.env.HTTP_PROXY || null;
const client = axios.create({ proxy: proxy ? false : undefined });
// if proxy set, use http-proxy-agent
if (proxy) {
  const HttpsProxyAgent = require('https-proxy-agent');
  client.defaults.httpsAgent = new HttpsProxyAgent(proxy);
}
await client.get('https://kms.example.com:7443/healthz');
```

ela: For SOCKS5 mention `socks-proxy-agent` and show how to detect and fallback. Also add a note about proxying UDP (WireGuard) vs TCP (KMS) and that WireGuard can't use typical HTTP proxies; suggest WireGuard-over-TCP fallback only when allowed and documented.

eng-sre: Quick ops asks: Add iptables/nftables rules to prevent accidental routing of production subnets over the egress proxy (explicit accept list for KMS IPs only). And include a smoke check that performs `dig @127.0.0.53 kms.example.com +short` and `curl --proxy $HTTPS_PROXY https://kms.example.com:7443/healthz`.

mohit: Air-gapped packaging: show an offline proxy bundle with CA certs for the proxy, proxy binary (squid), and a config that whitelists kms.example.com. Add a script to install CA into system trust stores (Debian/RHEL) and a one-liner to reload systemd-resolved.

kat: Docs nit: call out SDK timeout adjustments since proxies add latency. Recommend increasing connect timeout by 2-5s and using idempotent retries for admin-plane calls.

ela: I'll add: (1) split-DNS systemd and Unbound examples, (2) squid minimal conf with whitelisting and basic auth example, (3) Node + Python SDK proxy snippets, (4) smoke checks and firewall nftables snippet, (5) air-gap bundle manifest. Tagging eng-sre for validation.

docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/PROXY-DNS (files: docs/private/split-dns-egress-proxy.md, examples/squid-kms.conf, snippets/sdk-proxy-examples.md)

eng-sre: I'll smoke test the Unbound example on a VM and report back. For now mark PR "needs eng-sre validation".

ela: Thanks — will push updates in ~20m and request final review.
